title: Swaphix
tagline: Swaphix is a crypto to fiat payment manager for business implementing payments with GHO stablecoin.
description: Swaphix facilitates the adoption of crypto as a payment method, allowing you to pay with the GHO token in common businesses and making the user experience simple in receiving payments through a QR code, instantly depositing fiat money into your bank account to avoid exchange fluctuation and receive actual payment for your product or service.
how_its_made:
Our recipe is Node, RPC, API, Exchange and Bank Transfers. For the Backend we use JS, NodeJS and EthersJS technologies to build the API and deploy the RPCs for wallet creation, transfer, gas fee, balance, etc. The technologies used in the Frontend were React and Talwind.
Through this combination of technologies we build and facilitate the UI AND UX user experience, so that with a single click anyone can use GHO as a payment token.
